steps.code:
# Fetch all sent payment requests to ensure we have all from yesterday evening
all_requests = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_requests.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Filter requests created on 2023-05-19 after 18:00 (evening)
from datetime import datetime
evening_requests = []
for req in all_requests:
    created = datetime.fromisoformat(req["created_at"])
    if created.date().isoformat() == "2023-05-19" and created.hour >= 18:
        evening_requests.append(req)

print(f"Found {len(evening_requests)} evening requests")
for req in evening_requests:
    print(req["payment_request_id"], req["amount"], req["receiver"]["email"], req["description"])

# Delete each evening request and create a new one with corrected amount (70 - 15 = 55)
for req in evening_requests:
    req_id = req["payment_request_id"]
    receiver_email = req["receiver"]["email"]
    description = req["description"]
    private = req["private"]
    new_amount = req["amount"] - 15
    
    # Delete the original request
    del_resp = apis.venmo.delete_payment_request(payment_request_id=req_id, access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Deleted request {req_id}: {del_resp}")
    
    # Create new request with corrected amount
    create_resp = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=receiver_email,
        amount=new_amount,
        access_token=access_token,
        description=description,
        private=private
    )
    print(f"Created new request for {receiver_email} amount {new_amount}: {create_resp}")
